VI.description: Skeleton. Appends one line to a text file through a file REFNUM\3A Open/Create/Replace File (open or create)\2C Get File Size\2C Set File Position to the end\2C Write to Text File\2C Close File. The file is created when missing\3B an empty path gives a file error instead of a dialog. Copy the shapes\2C not the file.

The text to append\2C without its line end.
